rows.question: I am a Grade M3 employee planning a 7-hour flight for a business trip. Can I book a premium economy ticket directly, or do I need to use the company's travel desk?
rows.answer: As a Grade M3 employee, you are eligible to travel in premium economy for flights of 6 hours or more. However, you should book your ticket through the company's travel desk. If the travel desk cannot book the ticket within the required time and the fare is not higher than their quote, then you can book it directly and get reimbursed. Please ensure to follow the booking process through the travel desk to avoid any issues with reimbursement.

rows.question: Can employees work outside the core hours of 10:00 to 16:00 local time, and what are the conditions?
rows.answer: Yes, employees can work outside the core hours of 10:00 to 16:00 local time, as long as the contracted 40 hours per week are worked. Flexible start and finish times are allowed outside these core hours. However, employees must be available between 10:00 and 16:00 local time on working days. For any work-from-home days, employees must agree with their line manager in advance and record it in the HRMS attendance calendar by Friday of the preceding week. Line managers can also ask employees to attend the office on a planned work-from-home day for business reasons, giving at least 24 hours of notice.

rows.question: How much paid maternity leave do female employees in India receive, and what is the minimum service requirement to qualify?
rows.answer: Female employees in India with at least 80 days of service in the 12 months before the expected date of delivery are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. This is in line with the Government-Paid Maternity Leave scheme in India.

rows.question: I am a new joiner traveling to Singapore for a 4-day business trip. Can I claim full per diem, and how much will it be?
rows.answer: Yes, you can claim full per diem for your 4-day business trip to Singapore. The per diem rate for Singapore is SGD 90 per day. Therefore, for a 4-day trip, you can claim SGD 360 in total.

rows.question: What is the maximum value of gifts an employee can accept from a single party in a year without declaration?
rows.answer: Employees may accept gifts or hospitality from suppliers, shipyards, agents, or clients up to a value of USD 50 per occasion and USD 150 per year from the same party without declaration. Anything above these limits must be declined or declared to Compliance within 5 working days using the Gifts Register.

rows.question: How far in advance must leave be applied for, and what are the consequences for shorter absences?
rows.answer: For annual leave, you must apply at least 14 calendar days in advance if you want more than 3 consecutive working days. For shorter absences, you need to apply at least 2 working days in advance. Line managers must approve or decline your request within 3 working days of submission. If you don’t follow these rules, your leave might not be approved.

rows.question: I am a new joiner in Mumbai. Can I use my personal car for business travel, and if so, how much will I be reimbursed per kilometre?
rows.answer: Yes, you can use your personal car for business travel in Mumbai. You will be reimbursed at INR 12 per kilometre. However, this reimbursement is only applicable if the travel desk could not book within the required time and the fare is not higher than the travel desk quote.

rows.question: Can permanent staff work from another country, and if so, for how long and with what approval?
rows.answer: Permanent staff can work from another country for a maximum of 15 working days per calendar year. This requires approval from both the line manager and HR, given at least 10 working days in advance due to tax and immigration implications.

rows.question: How many working days of marriage leave are entitled to an employee, and when must it be taken?
rows.answer: Employees are entitled to 3 working days of paid marriage leave once during their employment with the company, to be taken within 1 month of the date of marriage.

rows.question: Can permanent shore staff accept a gift of USD 200 from a supplier in Mumbai, and if not, what must they do?
rows.answer: Permanent shore staff in Mumbai cannot accept a gift of USD 200 from a supplier, as this exceeds the limit of USD 50 per occasion and USD 150 per year from the same party. They must either decline the gift or declare it to Compliance within 5 working days using the Gifts Register.

rows.question: I just returned from a business trip and submitted my receipts, but I accidentally left out the receipt for a meal that cost INR 600. Can I still get reimbursed for it?
rows.answer: Yes, you can still get reimbursed for the meal receipt, but you will need to submit a signed missing-receipt declaration. This declaration is limited to two per year. Make sure to include it with your expense claim in the Expenses module of HRMS within 21 days of your return.

rows.question: How many days off do I get if my parent dies? Can I take them right away? How do I tell HR about it?
rows.answer: You are entitled to up to 5 working days of paid bereavement leave when a parent dies. You can take the leave right away, but you must record it in the HRMS within 5 working days of returning to work. There is no need to apply for this leave in advance, as it is considered compassionate leave.

rows.question: I'm a permanent employee in the Mumbai office and my probation ended last month. Can I work from home, and if so, how many days per week can I do that?
rows.answer: Yes, you can work from home. As a permanent employee who has completed probation, you are eligible to work from home for up to 2 days per week, subject to your role. However, roles that require physical presence, such as reception, the document control room, and the 24x7 fleet operations desk, are not eligible for regular work from home. Please discuss your work-from-home days with your line manager in advance and record them in the HRMS attendance calendar by Friday of the preceding week.

rows.question: A new employee in the Mumbai office has just completed 6 months on probation and wants to take 5 days of annual leave. When should they submit their request to avoid any issues?
rows.answer: Since the employee has completed 6 months on probation, they can now take annual leave. According to the policy, annual leave of more than 3 consecutive working days must be applied for at least 14 calendar days in advance. Therefore, they should submit their request at least 14 days before they wish to take the leave to avoid any issues.

rows.question: How should a permanent shore staff member request a work-from-home day, and what are the internet allowance details for a hybrid worker in Singapore?

For a hybrid worker in Singapore, the monthly internet allowance is SGD 30, paid through payroll. This allowance is provided to employees on a hybrid arrangement.

delta_tests.answer: The daily per diem allowance for domestic travel within India is INR 3,000 per day. This allowance covers meals, local incidentals, and laundry.
